name: Three-shot previs benchmark
description: Neutral three-shot fixture for measuring previs ability. Do not hard-code camera coordinates; required subjects must be readable at the requested shot scale.

shots.name: Lead medium
shots.description: Medium on the lead character. Head through waist; the second subject may be present but must not steal the frame.

shots.name: Two-subject overlap
shots.description: Both required subjects must be readable at a medium-full scale with deliberate foreground/background overlap.

shots.name: Crossing motion
shots.description: A short camera or blocking move that changes the frame between start and end. Still samples at start/mid/end plus one control video.
